items.title: The Old Fear-Based Paradigm Around Memory Cyclicality is Dead, So I’m Buying Micron
items.summary: Micron keeps getting dismissed as a cyclical chip stock doomed to repeat the same boom-and-bust pattern, but one structural shift buried in its latest earnings call suggests that logic no longer applies the way investors assume.

items.title: 3 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks to Research Further
items.summary: The stocks in this article have caught Wall Street’s attention in a big way, with price targets implying returns above 20%. But investors should take these forecasts with a grain of salt because analysts typically say nice things about companies so their firms can win business in other product lines like M&A advisory.

items.title: SanDisk Traded Margin Upside For Years Of Contracted Revenue
items.summary: The cap on gross margin that came with SanDisk's new supply contracts is what bought years of committed demand, and that trade is the case for the stock.

items.title: Chasing NVIDIA? Western Digital May Be the Smarter AI Bet
items.summary: Western Digital's AI storage demand drives strong revenues, margins and cash flow. See why WDC could deliver further upside.

items.title: Seagate Technology Gains From AI Boom: Is Long-Term Growth Secured?
items.summary: STX is riding AI-driven storage demand, with data center growth, long-term capacity deals and its HAMR-based Mozaic platform supporting expansion.

items.title: WDC Q2 Deep Dive: Market Reacts to Inventory Build Despite Strong AI-Driven Demand
items.summary: Leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 43.8% year on year to $3.75 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $4.1 billion at the midpoint, 1.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.56 per share was 7.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Can Western Digital Expand Margins on Higher-Capacity Drives?
items.summary: WDC's higher-capacity drives are lifting margins as favorable pricing, lower costs and new ePMR products support further expansion.

items.title: WDC Beats Q4 Expectations: More AI-Driven Upside Ahead for the Stock?
items.summary: Western Digital's 44% revenue growth, expanding margins and strong AI-driven storage demand signal continued earnings momentum.
